item.title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos

turns.text: Make three square listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug: one on pure white, one on a cosy breakfast table, and one close-up of the rim and glaze. Same mug in all three, realistic photos, no text. Send them as separate images.

item.tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: A plain sage-green ceramic mug; exact shape is your call, but keep it identical across all three images.
answer_sheet.Required views: A pure-white-background shot, a cosy breakfast-table lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the rim and glaze.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Realistic product photography, with a cosy mood for the lifestyle shot.
answer_sheet.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.

args.name: Sage ceramic mug — white listing photo

style.prompt: Realistic professional ecommerce product photograph, square composition. A single plain sage-green ceramic mug on a seamless pure white (#FFFFFF) background. Establish this exact distinctive product: straight cylindrical body with gently rounded bottom edge, matte satin sage-green glaze with subtle fine ceramic speckling, smoothly rounded slightly thick rim, matching sage-green glazed interior, one large rounded C-shaped handle on the right, no foot ring visible, no decoration, no logo. Empty mug. Three-quarter view from slightly above showing the interior and the complete handle, centered with generous white space, soft studio light, subtle natural contact shadow, accurate ceramic texture, crisp focus, true photographic realism. No text, no letters, no watermark, no props.

args.name: Sage ceramic mug — cosy breakfast table

style.prompt: Create a square realistic lifestyle product photograph using the EXACT SAME sage-green ceramic mug in the reference. Preserve its silhouette, dimensions, handle shape, rim thickness, sage color and glaze texture precisely. Change only the setting: place this mug prominently on a cosy natural oak breakfast table, soft cream linen napkin nearby, a croissant on a small off-white plate softly out of focus in the background, gentle morning window light, inviting warm neutral interior. Mug fully visible with its handle to the right, sharp focus on the mug, realistic contact shadows and ceramic texture, restrained editorial product photography. Keep the sage glaze color accurate, not yellow. No text, logos, labels or watermark.
